# DRAFT: Medical device adverse incident report

> This is a draft for human review. It has not been submitted. A manufacturer would report
> through the MHRA MORE portal; healthcare professionals and users report through the Yellow Card scheme.

## 1. Device
- Name: ClinicDrift-monitored DR screening model
- Version: v1.0
- Intended use: screening retinal photographs for referable diabetic retinopathy

## 2. Where and when
- Clinic: IN-APT-02 (APTOS 2019, India)
- Period: week 1 (starting 2026-01-05)

## 3. What happened
ClinicDrift detected that retinal scans from clinic IN-APT-02 no longer match the baseline images on which the artificial intelligence (AI) model was validated. The system calculated a drift score of 0.99 (where 0.5 indicates similarity to training data and 1 indicates a clear baseline difference).

Because expert grades for this week's 50 scans have not yet arrived, the catch rate (sensitivity for referable disease) cannot be verified. The AI model is referring a higher proportion of patients than usual: 82% of this week's scans, compared with 68% of training scans.

## 4. Potential patient impact
Because the catch rate cannot be verified, the number of potentially missed cases has not been estimated. No patient harm has been confirmed.

## 5. Likely cause
A severe reduction in image resolution and image quality metrics (sharpness, contrast, brightness) led to distribution drift and an increased referral rate. (Category: camera or image quality; confidence 85%; source: gemini)

Evidence:
- Drift score is 0.99, indicating that images differ significantly from the training/validation baseline.
- Mean image resolution decreased from 1020.0 px to 224.0 px (relative change -0.781).
- Mean quality dropped from 0.5 to 0.108 (relative change -0.784) and mean sharpness dropped from 0.000399 to 6.86e-05 (relative change -0.828).
- Mean contrast dropped from 0.0963 to 0.0648 (relative change -0.327) and mean brightness dropped from 0.373 to 0.298 (relative change -0.2).
- Mean referral score increased from 0.193 to 0.34 (relative change 0.763) and referral rate increased from 0.685 to 0.82 across 50 week 1 scans.

## 6. Action
ClinicDrift paused the AI model at this clinic because the scans drifted beyond the parameters on which the AI was validated, meaning its catch rate cannot be verified. It is recommended that this clinic's scans are sent for human grading until the checks below are completed.

Checks:
- [ ] Check image transfer and compression settings to verify why resolution dropped from 1020.0 px to 224.0 px.
- [ ] Inspect fundus camera lenses for dirt or smudges and check focus/illumination settings.
- [ ] Audit operator image acquisition techniques at clinic IN-APT-02.

## 7. Regulatory context
- Post-market surveillance (PMS): this alarm forms part of ongoing monitoring of the device in live use.
- Predetermined change control plan (PCCP): any model change made in response should fall within an agreed PCCP.
- MHRA AI Airlock Phase 2 report: see recommendations 3 and 4.

## 8. MIT AI Risk Repository tags
- 7.3 AI system safety, failures & limitations > Lack of capability or robustness
- 1.3 Discrimination & toxicity > Unequal performance across groups
- 5.1 Human-computer interaction > Overreliance and unsafe use
